changes.summary: Bound this recipe to the evidence-backed model capability authority without changing runtime behavior.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: The refreshed immutable checkpoint and language-model-only runtime contract are unchanged. A separate full-media identity remains deferred until the required vLLM audio extra and dependency inventory can be pinned exactly.
changes.summary: Made the existing Omni recipe explicitly text-only in its title, description, and capability tags.

changes.details: The sole upstream change after dc5f0b0b is a 234-byte README addition. Weights, configuration, tokenizer, remote code, launch guidance, vLLM 0.20.0 runtime, and the text-only single-Spark contract remain byte-identical.
changes.summary: Refreshed the immutable model snapshot after NVIDIA added its public training-content summary link; all executable artifacts and runtime pins are unchanged.

changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.
changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.

changes.details: The runtime image, source commit, dependency closure, adapter, and text-only launch arguments are unchanged; only authority metadata and its resulting content digest changed.
changes.summary: Corrected the vLLM 0.20.0 authority description and pinned drift monitoring to the immutable v0.20.0 tag.

changes.details: Language-model-only mode intentionally excludes audio, image, and video features, so every advertised capability is available without installing hidden runtime extras.
changes.summary: Converted the profile into an explicit executable text-serving recipe on NVIDIA's immutable vLLM 0.20.0 ARM64 runtime.
Applied FP8 KV, batching, and prefix caching while restricting qualification to text until multimodal controls are allowlisted.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B NVFP4 vLLM single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
